title: feat(plugin-dashboard): a drill opens a centred dialog over the standard list, and a report's chart marks drill
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbD5gxSWeWGswbZYVzNvtqNM)_

Part of #36256
Fixes #36550

This PR lands the drill dialog. One piece stays open on the card, carried by #36507: a labelled chip for a relationship-path condition (plugin-list `readViewConditions` / `viewChipText`, nested-relation form).

Clause-②: yes (widening) — additive members only, among them the new `PageRegionPostureReset` export of `@object-ui/components`; nothing is removed or renamed
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户在仪表盘或报表上点一个数字（柱子、扇区、折线点、指标卡、汇总行），原来从右侧滑出一个整高抽屉，现在在页面中央弹出一个约七成宽、六成半高的窗口，背后不变暗，里面就是对象列表页那张标准列表。
- 为什么做：这是仪表盘下钻体验改进的那张卡，维护者已批准的八点要求——条件变成可改可删的筛选标签、默认只显示名称和分组、度量字段、点名称进完整记录页并能上下翻、窗口里的操作都不保存。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是下钻窗口里列出的记录或默认列不对、或记录页的翻页顺序不对；什么都不写入，关掉窗口即复原，回退本合并即回到旧抽屉。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- **Centred dialog (items 1, 7).** On a desktop, a dashboard or dataset-report drill now opens a non-modal Radix dialog sized `w-[70vw] h-[65vh]`, using the shared dialog surface (#35980). Because it is non-modal, Radix draws no overlay: nothing behind it is dimmed or blurred. The header keeps the title and 「Open in list」, which is unchanged. On a phone (`useIsMobile`) the side drawer stays, with the same list inside.
- **The body is the standard list (item 5).** The new `DrillRecordList` mounts the registry's `list-view` (the block the object list page uses) through `SchemaRenderer`, bound with `dataSource: { object }`. It is read-only: `userActions` turns off inline edit, add record, row colour and grouping; `showViewSwitcher={false}`; and the dialog never receives a save-view, add, bulk, edit, delete, sort-change or filter-change callback. When `list-view` is not registered, the drill falls back to the dashboard's data table, and its rows no longer open a stacked record panel.
- **Conditions as the list's own chips (item 3).** The new `drillConditions.ts` splits the composed drill filter (widget filter, global filters, clicked bucket, measure scope) into the list's `initialFilters` rows, which are ordinary chips that can be edited and removed. Anything a chip row cannot say (a relationship path, `$or`, an unknown operator) stays the list's base `filter`, ANDed. A filter that is not the object form is lowered first. Examples are a page block's authored rule array `[{ field, operator, value }]` and an AST node. The lowering goes through the drill's own composition, `composeDrillFilter` in `@object-ui/core` (`mergeFilterNodes`, then the spec's `parseFilterAST`), and is not a new normaliser. A shape that cannot be lowered stays the list's base `filter` exactly as it arrived: one the conversion refuses (`FilterOperatorError`), and a non-empty one it answers nothing for (an array that is neither rules nor AST, a rule with a blank or missing field, a valid rule beside such an element). A string or number filter, which no list can read, lists nothing: the drawer shows its existing 「can't be listed from here」 notice and sends no read. No condition is ever dropped, and no drill reads every record. A condition stated twice is drawn once. On date fields, `$lt` and `$gt` are written as the list's own `before` and `after`, which lower to the same less-than and greater-than comparisons.
- **Default columns (item 4).** The defaults are the object's name field, then the grouped fields, then the range fields, then the measured fields. A relationship-path dimension or range field (`crm_account.industry`) shows its lookup field (`crm_account`) instead. The grid has no dotted-column support, so the lookup column (the account's name) stands in for the related value. This applies to the dashboard widget and the dataset report alike. The measured fields are read from the answer's `drillScopes` (`{field: {$null: false}}`). An authored `drillDown.columns` still wins. 「View settings → Add column」 adds any other field. Added columns and column calculations live only in the dialog's state.
- **Record name opens its full page (item 6).** `DrillNavigationContext` gains an optional `openRecord(objectName, id, {siblings, total})`. The app-shell hook implements it by navigating to the record page with history state `from = {pathname, label, siblings, total}`, the same shape a list hands the page it opens. The record page's existing stepper then reads 「1 of 3 · Pipeline Dashboard」, walks the drill rows, and its way back is the dashboard or report. `RecordDetailView` is unchanged.
- **Report chart marks drill (item 2).** `DatasetReportChart` passed no `onChartClick`. A bar now maps through `findChartSeriesRow` to the summary line it stands for, and both go through one builder (`emitBucketDrill`), so the bar and its line open the same records with the same default `fields`. `drilldown: false` still offers no click.
- **A host with no record page (page blocks).** The `object-metric` and `object-pivot` page blocks mount the drill without a `DrillNavigationProvider`, so there is no `openRecord`. There, a drilled row opens its record in a dialog (`RecordDetailDrawer`, `target: 'dialog'`), from both the standard list and the data-table fallback. Dashboard and report hosts are unchanged and open the record page.
  - The data-table fallback behaves exactly as on `main`.
  - The standard list reads only the fields it lists (`$select`). So its record dialog draws those fields, each with its value. It uses the authored `drillDown.columns` when given, as `ObjectDataTable` does. It does not list every field of the object with the unread ones shown as empty.
  - Values stay masked while the field types are unknown, through the drawer's `objectTypesPending` guard, as in the data table.
- **Inside a page, the standard list too (#36550).** React context crosses the dialog's portal, so a page block's drill list used to take the posture of the region holding the block. On a region half the page or wider that is the capped list: no toolbar, no chips, no pager, and a 「View all N」 link. That link went to the object's default list with no drill condition (L1-e measured it on HotCRM's 销售主页: 「查看全部 8 条」 landed on 10 open deals). `DrillRecordList` now clears the posture for its subtree with the new `PageRegionPostureReset` (`@object-ui/components`, next to `PageRegionPostureProvider`). The drill therefore draws the standard list everywhere, with its chips, record count and pager, and no 「View all」 link. The page's own list blocks keep their posture.
- **Nothing is written (item 8).** No view, no preference and no record write comes from the dialog. Measured in the browser and pinned in a test (see below).
- **Two `measuredFieldsOf` copies, on purpose.** One lives in plugin-dashboard `drillConditions.ts`, the other in plugin-report `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`, and no shared helper was added to `@object-ui/core`. Their predicates differ. The dashboard copy reads a measure scope that is already one record list, and takes a field only when its whole condition is `{$null: false}`. The report copy reads the answer's `drillScopes` per line, and takes every `$null: false` field it finds. A scope that adds other conditions on the same field gets a column in the report but not in the dashboard. This is a known edge.
- **New optional members:** `DrillNavigationValue.openRecord`, the `DrillRecordOrigin` type (`@object-ui/react`), `DrillDownDrawerProps.defaultColumns` and `DatasetDrillArgs.fields`. **New export:** `PageRegionPostureReset` (`@object-ui/components`, a `patch` entry (Metadata-protocol: none)).

## Tests

<details><summary>Unit and integration runs (head 0290ee50d3)</summary>

All runs below are under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, on head `0290ee50d3`.

- Drill suites, run from `ui/` with `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, covering:
  - plugin-dashboard: drillConditions, DrillDownDialog, DrillDownDrawer*, DatasetWidget*
  - plugin-report: all tests
  - app-shell: useOpenRecordList*, drillDialogStandardList-36256, ReportView*, DashboardView*

  Result: `Test Files  103 passed (103)` · `Tests  919 passed | 7 skipped (926)` · vitest exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` (derived): `Test Files  172 passed | 2 skipped (174)` · `Tests  5127 passed | 2 skipped (5129)` · exit 0.
- Reverse check on the rebuilt `.d.ts`: a probe passed `{ siblings: ['a'], bogus: 1 }` to `openRecord`. `tsc` turned red with `TS2353 ... 'bogus' does not exist in type 'DrillRecordOrigin'` (exit 2). The probe was then removed, and `git status` is clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Type-check (built closure)</summary>

- Built `@objectstack/spec` first, then `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' run build`. Both exit 0.
- `type-check` (the script name was echoed) exits 0 for each of `@object-ui/react`, `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, `@object-ui/plugin-report` and `@object-ui/app-shell`. Each runs `tsc --noEmit` and then `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`.
- Derived gates: `dispatch-gates --ran` reads `38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)`.
- `check-platform-checklist --changed-from origin/main`: OK.
- `overlap-check`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`. The check covers #36405 and #36420, and both merge cleanly.

</details>


<details><summary>CI fix round (head bd8af5cd8f)</summary>

Four reds on 0290ee50d3 and f8140a7d40, each reproduced locally and then shown green:
- **Type Check UI** was failing `check:spec-symbols`: the drill's chip-split file declared a local type named like a spec export (`Scalar`, owned by `@objectstack/spec/data`). The fix inlines the union. The check exits 1 on the old tree and 0 on the fix, measured with `@objectstack/spec` built. The other steps of the same job (`check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`) exit 0, and `type-check` exits 0 for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/app-shell` on the merged head.
- **Lint UI:** `react-hooks/globals` flagged the drill dialog test's stub, which wrote a module-level variable during render. The stub now reports its props through a `vi.fn` spy. `eslint` on the old file gives 1 error. `lint` exits 0 (0 errors) for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`, `@object-ui/plugin-report`, `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.
- **Test UI (10/16)** was failing `components/src/__tests__/dialogViewportGutterCensus-12603.test.ts`. The dialog lifted the width cap (`sm:max-w-none`), which the census reads as a wide dialog with no viewport gutter. It now caps at `max-w-[70vw]`, so the size is unchanged (70vw by 65vh) and the dialog keeps its own margin. The census fails 2 tests on the old tree; on the fix, the census plus the drill dialog suites read 4 files and 22 tests passed.
- **Test UI aggregate on 0290ee50d3:** its seven shards were cancelled mid-run, when the next push started the concurrency group's new run. None of them failed.
- **Build and E2E UI** failed in `check:eager-closure` before any spec ran: a superseded `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS` (main moved it, and nothing had grown). Merging `origin/main` (37367f3284) clears it, as the gate prescribes.

Readings on the new head:
- The sibling drill suites (all of plugin-dashboard, plugin-charts and plugin-report; app-shell drill*, ReportView*, DashboardView* and useOpenRecordList*; console drillDownReport*; types drill-down*): 382 files and 4043 tests passed.
- After the merge: 28 files and 230 tests passed.
- `vitest run scripts/`: 172 files passed.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `overlap-check`: clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Round 7 (no dropped filter, standard list inside a page)</summary>

**M6, a non-empty filter the conversion answered nothing for.** `composeDrillFilter` answers `undefined` without throwing for an array that is neither rules nor AST, a rule with a blank or missing field, and a valid rule beside such an element. `drillListConditions` read that as no filter, so the drill listed every record. Now a non-empty input (anything but `undefined`, `null`, `[]` or `{}`) whose conversion comes back empty is kept as the list's base filter, the same as the throwing path.
- Measured with the real plugin-list over `ValueDataSource`: each such array reaches the read as `$filter` (a server refuses it as malformed), and the open deal is never listed.
- A string or a number cannot be kept that way. The list's own `toFilterNode` reads a non-object as no filter, so the read went out with no `$filter` and listed 3 of 3 rows. `DrillDownDrawer` now shows its existing `unavailable` notice for such a filter and mounts no list, so no read is sent. This adds no new copy.

**#36550, the page region's posture inside the drill.** `DrillRecordList` wraps its subtree in the new `PageRegionPostureReset`. As L1-e found, the capped list's 「View all N」 link inside the drill came from the host's `compactListDestination`: the object's default view, with no drill condition. That link is no longer drawn there.

**Pins, red on 942e9c2f17's `drillConditions.ts`, `DrillDownDrawer.tsx` and `DrillRecordList.tsx`, then green.** Red: `12 failed | 15 passed (27)`. Green: `27 passed (27)`. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, then checked: `git diff HEAD` empty and the blob hashes match.
- `drillConditions-36256.test.ts`: six inputs the conversion answers nothing for (an array of a bare object, a blank field, no field, a valid rule beside a malformed one, a string, a number) stay the base filter as they arrived. `undefined`, `null`, `[]` and `{}` are still no filter. N8: an `and` node lowers to chips; an `or` node, and a rule array's any-of group, go to the base filter as `$or`. The N8 cases are green on both sides, because they pin behaviour that already held.
- `app-shell/.../pageBlockDrillFilter-36256.test.tsx`: the three arrays above, each with every read carrying `$filter` and the open deal not listed. The string and the number show the `unavailable` notice and send no read.
- `app-shell/.../pageBlockDrillPosture-36550.test.tsx`: the real page renderer, `object-metric` and `list-view`, with the region widths stubbed. The drill in the `main` region (856 of 1200 px) shows the chip `filter-chip-stage`, 「2 records」, no capped table and no 「View all」 link. CONTROL: the page's own `list-view` block in the same region stays capped (3 capped rows and 「View all 3」). Red: no chip in the dialog.

**Live re-check on HotCRM 销售主页.** Branch Console at de4dfdf456 over HotCRM `origin/main` (689166c). The same local-only `drillDown` was added to `kpi_revenue_won`; it was not committed and was reverted afterwards.
- The tile reads 1,290,000. The drill dialog draws the standard list: the toolbar, the chip 「阶段：成交」, the columns 商机名称 / 所属客户 / 金额 / 预计成交日期, 8 rows and 「8 条记录」.
- No 「查看全部」 link and no capped table inside the dialog. The page's own list blocks stay capped (3 capped tables on the page).
- The 8 rows are exactly HotCRM's 8 `closed_won` opportunities out of 23.
- The read: `/api/v1/data/crm_opportunity?populate=crm_account&top=25&select=id,name,crm_account,amount,close_date,stage&filter=["stage","=","closed_won"]`.
- Shot: project files `repo-objectstack-7/card-36256/hotcrm-r7-sales-home-drill.png`.

**Runs on de4dfdf456.** That tree was pushed as 8e8c3bfb78, which differs only in a reworded trailer. a9d781de2f then changes only the changeset's `@object-ui/components` grade from `minor` to `patch`, as the `Check Changeset` level axis requires under `Metadata-protocol: none` (run offline with this body as the event: exit 0). plugin-dashboard + plugin-report: 251 files, 2425 passed / 13 skipped. components: 505 files (1 skipped), 4914 passed / 24 skipped. app-shell drill and page-block suites plus plugin-list's three posture pins: 15 files, 168 passed. type-check exit 0 for components, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report and app-shell. lint 0 errors for components, plugin-dashboard and app-shell. `overlap-check`: `VERDICT clean exit 0`, with 0 open PR heads sharing a file, the components index included.

</details>

<details><summary>Round 6 (page-block drill filter)</summary>

**The defect.** Found live by L1-e, on HotCRM's 销售主页 tile 总收入（全部期间）.
- The tile is an `object-metric` block whose `filter` is the spec's rule array, `[{ field: 'stage', operator: 'equals', value: 'closed_won' }]`.
- The drill list split only an object-form filter, so it received neither chips nor a base filter. It listed all 23 opportunities where the tile counts 8.
- **Main kept the filter.** On main the drill went to the data table, which handed the array to `$filter` as written. The adapter lowers it.
- Measured on origin/main a3ee8621ed with the same object-metric fixture over an in-memory matcher. The read's `$filter` was `[{"field":"stage","operator":"equals","value":"closed_won"}]`, and the rows were the 2 won deals only.
- So this PR introduced the regression, and round 6 fixes it.

**Pins, each run red on b91ec497b5's `drillConditions.ts` and `DrillRecordList.tsx`, then green.** Red: `4 failed | 7 passed (11)`. Green: 11/11.
- `plugin-dashboard/__tests__/pageBlockDrillFilter-36256.test.tsx`:
  - An `object-metric` block with the HotCRM rule array: the drill list gets the chip `stage equals closed_won`. Red: `expected { chips: [], base: undefined }`.
  - An `object-pivot` block with the same rule array: the drill list gets the block's condition and the clicked cell's. This one is green on both sides, because the pivot composes through `composeDrillFilter` before the drill.
- `app-shell/src/views/pageBlockDrillFilter-36256.test.tsx`: the real `@object-ui/plugin-list` over `ValueDataSource`. The drill lists exactly the won records the tile sums, never the open one, and its read's `$filter` carries `closed_won`. Red: the open deal was listed.
- `drillConditions-36256.test.ts`:
  - A rule array lowers to a chip, and so does an AST node.
  - A shape the spec refuses (`[['stage', 'in', 'won']]`) stays the base filter exactly as it arrived.

**Live re-check on HotCRM.** Branch Console, HotCRM `origin/main` on 18.6.0. A local-only `drillDown` (`{ enabled: true, target: 'dialog', columns: ['name','crm_account','amount','close_date'] }`) was added to `kpi_revenue_won`; it was not committed and was reverted afterwards.
- The tile reads 1,290,000, and the drill lists 8 rows.
- Those rows are exactly HotCRM's 8 `closed_won` opportunities (out of 23), each with stage `closed_won`.
- The read: `/api/v1/data/crm_opportunity?populate=crm_account&top=25&select=id,name,crm_account,amount,close_date,stage&filter=["stage","=","closed_won"]`.
- Shot: project files `repo-objectstack-7/card-36256/hotcrm-r6-sales-home-drill.png`.

</details>

<details><summary>Round 5 (S3, S4, N4; head b91ec497b5)</summary>

All runs are under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, from `ui/` with `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`.

- **S3 pin** (`ObjectMetricWidget.drillOpensRecord-36256`, a new case). The list stub answers with the record projected to its listed columns, the way the list's `$select` read does. The object has 5 fields, and the drill lists 3.
  - Red: `DrillRecordList.tsx` at c59a3fc087 gives `1 failed | 2 passed (3)`, with `expected [ 'Name', 'Stage', 'Amount', …(2) ] to deeply equal [ 'Name', 'Stage', 'Amount' ]`.
  - Green: restored with `git checkout HEAD --` and `git diff HEAD` empty, giving 3/3.
- **S4.**
  - The `openRecord` jsdoc now reads "Absent ⇒ the drill opens the record in a dialog."
  - DELIBERATE CORRECTION of `.changeset/36256-drill-dialog-standard-list.md`. Its last sentence now reads: "A renderer without `@object-ui/plugin-list` registered lists the drilled records in the dashboard's data table. A host that gives no `openRecord` (a page block's metric or pivot) opens the drilled record in a dialog, from either body."
- **N4.** `range.field` takes its first segment in both `DatasetWidget` and `emitBucketDrill`.

Other readings on b91ec497b5:
- plugin-dashboard + plugin-report in full: `Test Files  250 passed (250)` · `Tests  2411 passed | 13 skipped (2424)` · exit 0.
- `type-check` exits 0 for plugin-dashboard, plugin-report and react, after the closure build. `lint` gives 0 errors for all three.
- `vitest run scripts/`: 172 files passed.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `overlap-check`: clean.

</details>

<details><summary>Round 4 (head 5af2f6e3af)</summary>

All runs are under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, from `ui/` with `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`.

- Red, then green, with the round-4 source reverted to the round-3 head (0a480510dd) and then restored (byte-compared with `cmp`, and the marker `grep -c` read 0 then 1):
  - The path-column pins: red 2 failed / 2 passed (4), green 4/4. Covers `DatasetWidget` and `DatasetReportRenderer.chartMarkDrill-36256`.
  - The S1, S2 and N2 pins: red 3 failed / 9 passed (12), green 12/12.
  - The red reasons: `expected [ 'amount' ] to deeply equal [ 'crm_account', 'amount' ]`, and `Unable to find [data-testid="record-detail-body"]` (twice).
- The N2 phone pin, by mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (`&& !phone` removed): `1 failed | 6 passed (7)`. The restore was verified as blob equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- The full plugin-dashboard + plugin-report run: `Test Files  250 passed (250)` · `Tests  2410 passed | 13 skipped (2423)` · exit 0.

- `type-check` (the script name was echoed, and it chains `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exits 0 for `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` and `@object-ui/plugin-report`, after building the `^...` closure.
- `lint` exits 0 for both, with 0 errors.

</details>

New card-named tests:
- `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/drillConditions-36256.test.ts`: chip rows versus the base filter, de-duplication, date bound wording, and measured fields.
- `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DrillDownDialog-36256.test.tsx`:
  - The dialog is centred and sized, with no overlay.
  - The list schema is read-only.
  - The chips, the default columns, and that added columns and calculations stay in local state.
  - The record name calls `openRecord` with the shown rows and closes the drill.
  - Phone keeps the drawer: `useIsMobile` is mocked true, and a mutation of the phone branch turns it red. Without `list-view` registered, no panel is stacked.
- `app-shell/src/views/drillDialogStandardList-36256.test.tsx`: the real `@object-ui/plugin-list`. The chips are removable, and a removal re-reads without the condition. There are zero `create/update/delete/bulk` calls, no non-GET fetch and no `localStorage.setItem`. Columns lead with Name, then the drilled fields.
- `app-shell/src/views/useOpenRecordList.drillRecordPage-36256.test.tsx`: `openRecord` drives `useRecordPageReturn`, giving the stepper 2 of 3, next to 3 of 3, and back to the dashboard URL including its query.
- `plugin-report/src/__tests__/DatasetReportRenderer.chartMarkDrill-36256.test.tsx`: a bar and its summary line emit the same `objectFilter` and `fields`. `drilldown: false` offers no click. A `crm_account.industry` line drills on the nested condition with fields `['crm_account', 'amount']`.
- `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DatasetWidget.drillDialog-36256.test.tsx`: `DatasetWidget` itself opens the dialog (`target="dialog"`, `open`), with these default columns:
  - A chart mark (`onSegmentClick`): the grouped field, then the range field, then `measuredFieldsOf(scope)`, which gives `['stage', 'close_date', 'amount']`.
  - A metric tile: `measuredFieldsOf(readMeasureDrillScope(...))`, which gives `['amount']`.
  - A `crm_account.industry` slice: `['crm_account', 'amount']`.
- `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/ObjectMetricWidget.drillOpensRecord-36256.test.tsx`: an `object-metric` block with no provider opens the drilled record in a dialog, from the standard list and from the data-table fallback.

Changed tests:
- `DrillDownDrawer.chain.test.tsx` is split by host: with a record page, the fallback rows are inert; with no record page, they stay drill-to-record.
- `summarySubtotals-27975` now expects `fields: ['owner_id']` on the subtotal drill.

## Acceptance notes

**HotCRM walk (round 4).** Branch Console at 5af2f6e3af's source, against HotCRM booted from the published 18.6.0 packages. Desktop at 1440×1000, zh-CN. The executive dashboard (高管总览) and the 各阶段商机 report.

- **行业收入分布, slice 科技.** The dialog opens with 3 records. The columns are 商机名称, 所属客户 and 金额, so the lookup column stands in for the industry. The industry condition is a locked chip reading 「所属客户：= [object Object]」. That is the remainder carried by #36507. It does not read "View filter".
  ![industry slice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/5290b53bed7b42c0dbbd1a3c1dc23b4a36d4c512/hotcrm-industry-slice.png)
- **收入趋势, month 2026年8月.** 1 record. The chips are the 12-month window plus the bucket: 预计成交日期 ≥ 2026-08-01 and 早于 2026-09-01. The columns are 商机名称, 预计成交日期 and 金额.
- **年度累计收入 tile (1,290,000).** 8 records. The chips are 阶段：成交, the date bounds and 金额. The columns are 商机名称 and 金额.
